column2: Retain John coming from Gazara and reporting Cendebaeus’s acts to his father Simon. The patronal relationship distinguishes John from earlier namesakes.
Retain the two elder sons, family service from youth to today and rescue prospering in their hands many times. The difficult impersonal prosperity construction remains a provisional close rendering.
column3: How can the hands/prosperity wording be made more natural without assigning an unexpressed divine subject? Full literary and syntactic review remains pending.

column2: Retain old age, maturity through mercy, replacement of Simon and his brother, national defence and a wish for heavenly help. Mercy’s giver is not explicitly named, and you addresses the sons rather than God.
Retain singular He choosing, twenty thousand warriors and cavalry, march and lodging at Modein. Do not name the choosing subject or distribute the count beyond what the grammar warrants.
column3: Does He resume Simon or introduce John, and does twenty thousand include cavalry or qualify the warriors alone? Both questions remain open.

column2: Propose restoring Behold before the large opposing force. Keep morning, plain, infantry/cavalry and the intervening stream; no river name is supplied.
Retain the unnamed leader’s encampment, people’s fear, his first crossing and their following. The English keeps He rather than resolving the source’s omitted name prematurely.
Retain division of the people and cavalry among infantry because enemy cavalry was numerous. The placement is explicit, but no modern formation diagram is asserted.
Retain trumpets, Cendebaeus’s rout, many wounded and survivors fleeing to the stronghold. Wounded must not be uniformly converted to killed.
Retain Judas wounded and John pursuing to Kedron. Cendebaeus as builder is supplied from chapter 15’s context, not an explicit name in this unit’s final clause.
Retain towers near Azotus, singular burned it, about two thousand fallen and peaceful return. Do not silently change the feminine singular object to plural towers.
column3: Does it refer to Azotus, Kedron or another implied place? The inherited pronoun preserves the selected difficulty without deciding the destroyed site.

column2: Retain Ptolemy son of Abubus, command of Jericho’s plain and much silver/gold. This officer is not conflated with the Egyptian kings sharing his name.
Retain his being the high priest’s son-in-law. The relationship explains the preceding position/wealth context without naming the wife.
Retain lifted heart, desire for territorial control and deceitful plan against Simon/sons. The pride image and murderous intent remain distinct.
Retain Simon’s civic inspection, Mattathias/Judas, Jericho, year 177 and eleventh month Shebat. No calendar conversion or replacement of the named sons is made.
Retain Abubus’s son, small stronghold Dok, deceitful reception, drinking feast and concealed men. Small reflects the diminutive; no exact building dimensions are supplied.
Retain Simon/sons becoming drunk, armed intrusion and murder of father, two sons and some attendants. Intoxication is explicit and should not be euphemized as mere enjoyment of the meal.
Retain great treachery and evil repaid for good. The moral evaluation is in the source and remains.
Retain Ptolemy’s report to the king, requested help and handing over country/cities. The subject and beneficiary of the final handing-over clause remain syntactically difficult.
column3: Does the king hand territory to Ptolemy, or does Ptolemy offer it to the king? The inherited English tends toward the first and is not treated as settled.

column2: Retain assassins sent to Gazara and letters enticing commanders of thousands with silver/gold/gifts. The military title is not a new troop total.
Retain additional men sent to seize Jerusalem and the temple mountain. The two targets remain, without narrating a successful seizure.
Retain the unnamed runner’s warning, father/brothers dead and the shift to direct you in the killing threat. Men is contextually supplied as the sent agents.
Retain astonishment, seizure and killing of the intended attackers because their aim was known. The repeated destroy language is not shortened into an unqualified political purge.
Retain the remaining deeds, wars, brave acts, built walls and actions as the heading for the closing record formula. The repeated action/building wording remains across the sentence boundary.

Retain the already-present behold, written record of high-priestly days and succession after his father. The source reference is not treated as an accessed surviving document or filled with invented additional deeds.
